question: Does an existing single-scene app lose automatic UIKit/SwiftUI view or action coverage when rebuilt with the iOS27 SDK and run on Duo, without adopting semantic tracking or changing navigation?

duo_phases: inner flow after real open with geometry receipt

unchanged_application_contract: scene manifest declares multiple scenes false
no RUMNavigationHost, scene target or experimental API
same app source in every arm; genuine compiler/SDK identity retained
UI test identifiers, mapper observation and independent native interaction/geometry receipts only

views: detected name/path and ordered unique occurrences
owner retained or changed across presentation, navigation and geometry
actions: real native tap/scroll outcome required before assessing detection
action type/name/count and originating view relationship
no custom marker counted as automatic action
oracle.acceptance: Every finite cell has a classified outcome; all four gates require no new unexplained loss, duplicate or ownership/name degradation. Pre-existing imperfections remain visible, never silently accepted as ideal semantics.
integrity: fresh UUID and clean installation each cell
native outcome independent of RUM discovery
timestamps and sequence retained through critical boundary
negative controls reject wrong owners, missing actions and stale run evidence
oracle.evidence_boundary: Primary comparison uses complete local RUM mapper events, not a backend claim. Existing semantic-host acceptance is not reused as automatic tracking evidence.

environment_limits: Installed27.1 runtime supports Duo only. The regular control runs27.0; cross-device deltas alone cannot isolate hardware/model from OS patch. Same-device old/new build pairs isolate rebuild changes.
Simulator functional observation does not establish physical Duo performance or callback parity.
Single scene declared false is the immediate no-adoption contract; simultaneous windows and declared-multi-scene variants remain their separate gates.
